_readme: PDD (calendar year) vs Alibaba e-commerce segment (fiscal year ending Mar 31), RMB billion. See pipeline/README.md '与阿里巴巴电商对比' section for sourcing notes and how to extend this with a new year.

pdd_capex_source.note: PDD's 6-K quarterly releases never disclose capex/FCF. Pulled from the 20-F annual reports' full cash flow statement (line 'Purchase of property, equipment and software (and intangible assets)').

alibaba_ebita_source.note: Alibaba's segment Adjusted EBITA pulled from the 'Segment information' note in each year's 20-F (Item 18 financial statements), not from quarterly 6-K press releases (too many near-duplicate HKEX filings around results season to reliably script).

segment_definition_by_era.FY2018-2021: 核心商业 Core Commerce (bundles China commerce + International commerce + Local consumer services + Cainiao logistics; not split out yet)
segment_definition_by_era.FY2022-2023: 中国商业 China commerce + 国际商业 International commerce
segment_definition_by_era.FY2024-2026: 阿里中国电商事业群 Alibaba China E-commerce Group + 阿里国际数字商业集团 Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group (restated structure)
